rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP gateway that aggregates multiple downstream MCP servers behind a single interface, exposing just 3 tools (~2k tokens) instead of loading all server tools upfront (5k-50k+ tokens). Built with FastMCP 2.0, provides on-demand tool discovery through list_servers, get_server_tools, and execute_tool. Features per-agent access control via configurable policy rules with wildcard patterns and deny-before-allow precedence, hot configuration reload, transparent proxying to stdio and HTTP MCP servers with OAuth support, comprehensive audit logging, and performance metrics tracking.
